verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs say users can connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat, and show the GitHub MCP server being used from Copilot Chat in the IDE (with remote or local setup in VS Code). The evidence is thin: it covers only IDE Copilot Chat, frames MCP as 'sharing context' rather than explicitly invoking server tools, and gives no configuration depth. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Copilot invokes arbitrary third-party MCP servers' tools, evidence of MCP support in Copilot CLI and the cloud agent, configuration/management details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications.
use the GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests, and other GitHub features, directly from Copilot Chat in your IDE.
The GitHub MCP server in Visual Studio Code can be configured remotely or locally.
